materials_exhausted.notes: Local XML, main PDF text, SI PDF text from the OA package, figure captions, locator index, packet database rows, and merged DBAASP sequence/experiment rows were checked for the worker-2/4/6 blockers.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 bounded re-review repaired the previous hard blocker: two primary-source MIC rows are now recorded, DBAASP strain/sequence conflicts are preserved rather than forced to source_verified, and final review provenance/QC no longer depends on the framework test summary.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: The literature link is source_verified. Six linked DBAASP MIC assay/experiment rows remain source_conflict because their strain labels do not match the primary SI strains. The merged DBAASP sequence row is sequence_modified_not_normalized because X placeholders differ from the primary precursor sequence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The main paper and SI support Bottromycin D MIC 2 ug/mL against MSSA ATCC 29213 and MRSA ATCC 33591. No hemolysis/cytotoxicity rows for Bottromycin D were recovered from local primary material.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The source supports bacteriostatic phenotypic action under tested conditions and RiPP/bst-cluster biosynthetic evidence. No unsupported direct molecular killing mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_gate_decision: All prior blocking rework targets are closed after source review. Remaining issues are caution-level preserved conflicts, not open blocker tickets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Six DBAASP assay/experiment rows carry MIC 2 ug/mL but use Staphylococcus aureus 209P, Smith, or MRSA clinical-isolate labels that are not the ATCC 29213/ATCC 33591 strains named in the local primary SI.
Merged DBAASP sequence catalog uses GXAXXXDC while the primary paper reports GPAVVFDC as the precursor-encoded sequence; X placeholders were preserved instead of normalized.
The OA package includes an SI PDF that was text-indexed and checked for MIC/method details; no separate spreadsheet/table supplement was present in the local packet.
The local source supports bacteriostatic phenotypic action and RiPP biosynthetic evidence, but not a source-reviewed direct molecular killing target for Bottromycin D.
